assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background panorama for a side-scrolling 2D pixel-art fantasy game, 1536x1024 landscape. Paint a beautiful enchanted woodland at early golden morning, sophisticated handcrafted pixel art, clustered pixel texture, layered deep teal and sage woodland silhouettes, ancient tall twisting trees and broad leafy canopy framing the upper corners, sunbeams through pale mint mist in the open center, distant tiny forest ruins and a subtle winding stream low in frame. Rich atmospheric depth, restrained warm ivory and golden amber highlights, dark turquoise edges, luminous soft center. Side elevation environment backdrop, NOT an isometric view. Entire lower quarter dark teal undergrowth. Keep the middle 65 percent quiet with distant trees and mist so small playable characters and floating platforms remain very readable. No characters, no monsters, no text, no UI, no floating platforms, no ground collision tiles, no border. Original premium indie game art, crisp deliberate pixels and beautiful botanical detail, not flat geometric trees.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production background panorama for a 2D side scrolling fantasy pixel art game, landscape 1536x1024. Ancient underground forest shrine inside a vast crystal cavern, beautiful handcrafted pixel art with intentional crisp pixel clusters, deep indigo navy and dark teal rock arches framing upper corners, distant weathered stone arches and ruins, turquoise bioluminescent crystals and tiny violet fungi in lower corners, pale blue luminous mist through the center, elegant restrained atmosphere. Bottom quarter dark rock and subtle roots. No characters, no monsters, no text, no HUD, no floating platforms, no borders, no ground tiles. Premium original pixel-art indie fantasy environment, visually consistent with a richly detailed enchanted woodland.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite animation atlas, transparent background. EXACT regular grid of 4 columns by 6 rows, total 24 separate sprites. Canvas 1024x1536. Each cell 256 square. No grid lines, no text, no shadows on ground. Every creature centered in its cell with generous transparent padding, no overlap. Each ROW depicts the SAME creature in four animation poses left to right: resting, squash anticipation, lifted walking step, alternate walking step. All face LEFT in a readable side / three-quarter game view. Polished handcrafted pixel art, crisp outlined pixel clusters, luminous highlights, rich 5-tone shading, cute fantasy RPG creatures, NOT vector shapes or smooth 3D. Strong personality and silhouette. Row 1: small round emerald jelly forest spirit with a tiny two-leaf sprout on head, glossy translucent turquoise shaded body, little dark expressive eyes, pale cheeks. Row 2: adorable walking orange-red woodland mushroom with layered cream gills, asymmetrical speckled cap, little scarf of moss, stubby brown feet and a cream face. Row 3: tiny plum-purple bat, huge inner rose ears, scalloped indigo wings in different flapping positions, golden eyes and two tiny teeth. Row 4: hulking ancient mossy stone golem, irregular carved stone limbs, teal glowing rune in chest, amber eyes, leafy plants and mushrooms on shoulders, beautifully textured beveled slate stone, NOT a rectangular robot. Row 5: mischievous round midnight-blue alchemical bomb creature with brass bands, tiny feet, glowing orange fuse flame and expressive gold eyes. Row 6: ancient forest tree guardian boss, gnarled roots for feet, branching arms, lush clustered emerald leaf canopy, tiny amber mushrooms, glowing amber eyes, carved wooden mask face, rich bark texture. Keep creature identity, colors and scale identical across each row's four frames. Whole bodies fully visible including wings roots and foliage. Professional cohesive magical woodland pixel art bestiary sprite sheet. Transparent alpha background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game CHARACTER ANIMATION SPRITE ATLAS on truly transparent background. EXACT regular grid 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 cells each 256x256 on 1024x1024 canvas. Each character fully inside cell with 24 pixels padding, consistent SAME SIZE and design throughout; feet on same baseline in each cell, no ground shadows, no text or grid. One original adorable chibi forest adventurer, 2.5 heads tall, tousled chestnut-brown hair with a small pale leaf ornament, expressive warm hazel eyes, cream neck scarf, tailored dark emerald short coat with brass clasps and leather crossbody belt and pouch, flowing short sage-green cape, dark brown trousers, warm brown buckled boots and fingerless gloves. Beautiful detailed pixel-art fantasy RPG style, dark clean outlines, controlled clustered pixels and rich sculpted shading, warm highlights, readable sweet but determined face. No weapon in any frame: weapons will be rendered separately by game engine. Side view always facing LEFT except explicitly back-facing climb row. Row 1 four poses: idle relaxed arms down; run stride left leg forward; run passing stride; run stride right leg forward, cape streaming right. Row 2: airborne jump with tucked legs; falling arms out; crouched landing; low forward dodge roll tucked crouching silhouette. Row 3: melee anticipation hand above head; powerful melee arm extended left at chest height; melee followthrough arm low in front; casting magic with empty left hand extended left, no effects. Row 4: archer pose with both empty hands aiming left, no bow; throwing with empty forward hand extended left; climbing front of ladder with BACK TO VIEWER arms raised, no ladder; alternate back-facing climbing step, no ladder. Keep same face, outfit, proportion and alignment for every pose. This is a working game sprite sheet, separate isolated figures with transparency, polished charming hand-painted pixel-art to match woodland creatures.
